title: Orchestration Patterns: Supervisor, Swarm, Hierarchical — The Main Shapes
titleKn: Orchestration ಮಾದರಿಗಳು: Supervisor, Swarm, Hierarchical — ಮುಖ್ಯ ಆಕಾರಗಳು
desc: How supervisor, swarm and hierarchical structures organise multiple agents and where control and information flow in each.

title: Orchestration Patterns: Supervisor, Swarm, Hierarchical — Routing, State and Handoffs
desc: How work is routed to agents, what state is shared, and how hand-offs preserve the information that matters.
objectives: Explain routing by rules versus by a model.
Decide what state is shared and what stays private.
Design hand-off messages that carry needed context.
objectivesKn: ನಿಯಮ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾದರಿ ಮೂಲಕ routing ವಿವರಿಸಿ.
ಅಗತ್ಯ context ಹೊತ್ತ ಹಸ್ತಾಂತರ ಸಂದೇಶ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ.

Ambiguous requests may need a model to decide, at higher cost and variance.","bodyKn":"ಸರಳ, ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ವರ್ಗಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಯಮ ಅಥವಾ ಸಣ್ಣ classifier ರೂಟ್ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು: ವೇಗ ಮತ್ತು ಊಹಿಸಬಹುದಾದ. ಅಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ವಿನಂತಿಗೆ ಮಾದರಿ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸಬೇಕಾಗಬಹುದು, ಹೆಚ್ಚು ವೆಚ್ಚ ಮತ್ತು ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Shared Versus Private State","headingKn":"ಹಂಚಿದ vs ಖಾಸಗಿ State","bodyEn":"Shared state lets agents see each other's results but can leak irrelevant detail and cause conflicts. Keeping most state private and passing explicit messages keeps agents focused and easier to test.","bodyKn":"ಹಂಚಿದ state agents ಗೆ ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ನೋಡಲು ಬಿಡುತ್ತದೆ ಆದರೆ ಅಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ವಿವರ ಸೋರಿ ಘರ್ಷಣೆ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡಬಹುದು. ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ state ಖಾಸಗಿ ಇಟ್ಟು ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ಸಂದೇಶ ನೀಡಿದರೆ agents ಕೇಂದ್ರೀಕೃತ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"What a Hand-Off Must Carry","headingKn":"ಹಸ್ತಾಂತರ ಏನು ಹೊತ್ತಿರಬೇಕು","bodyEn":"A hand-off should state the goal, what has been done, what remains, constraints and any artifacts, not just "please continue". Missing context is the top cause of poor hand-offs.","bodyKn":"ಹಸ್ತಾಂತರ ಗುರಿ, ಏನು ಮಾಡಲಾಗಿದೆ, ಏನು ಉಳಿದಿದೆ, ನಿರ್ಬಂಧಗಳು, ವಸ್ತುಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸಬೇಕು, ಕೇವಲ "ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಿ" ಅಲ್ಲ. ಕೊರತೆ context ಕಳಪೆ ಹಸ್ತಾಂತರದ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಕಾರಣ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Guard Against Loops","headingKn":"Loops ವಿರುದ್ಧ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ","bodyEn":"Agents can hand the same task back and forth. Track the hand-off path, set a maximum number of hops and stop with an explanation if it is exceeded.","bodyKn":"agents ಒಂದೇ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಹಿಂದೆ ಮುಂದೆ ಕೊಡಬಹುದು. ಹಸ್ತಾಂತರ ಹಾದಿ ಗಮನಿಸಿ, ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಹಾಪ್ ಮಿತಿ ಹಾಕಿ, ಮೀರಿದರೆ ವಿವರಣೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Key Takeaways","headingKn":"ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳು","bodyEn":"• Route by rules when categories are clear.
• Prefer private state and explicit messages.
• Hand-offs must carry goal, progress and constraints; cap hops.","bodyKn":"• ವರ್ಗ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾದರೆ ನಿಯಮ ರೂಟಿಂಗ್.
• ಖಾಸಗಿ state, ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ಸಂದೇಶ.
• ಹಸ್ತಾಂತರದಲ್ಲಿ ಗುರಿ, ಪ್ರಗತಿ, ನಿರ್ಬಂಧ; ಹಾಪ್ ಮಿತಿ."}},{"type":"quiz","data":{"questions":[{"q":"When is rule-based routing appropriate?","qKn":"ನಿಯಮ ಆಧಾರಿತ routing ಯಾವಾಗ ಸೂಕ್ತ?","opts":["When categories are simple and well defined","When requests are ambiguous","Never","Always"],"optsKn":["ವರ್ಗಗಳು ಸರಳ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾದಾಗ","ವಿನಂತಿ ಅಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾದಾಗ","ಎಂದಿಗೂ ಇಲ್ಲ","ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ"],"correct":0},{"q":"What should a hand-off contain?","qKn":"ಹಸ್ತಾಂತರದಲ್ಲಿ ಏನಿರಬೇಕು?","opts":["Goal, progress, remaining work and constraints","Only please continue","Nothing","A random number"],"optsKn":["ಗುರಿ, ಪ್ರಗತಿ, ಉಳಿದ ಕೆಲಸ, ನಿರ್ಬಂಧ","ಕೇವಲ ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಿ","ಏನೂ ಇಲ್ಲ","ಯಾದೃಚ್ಛಿಕ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ"],"correct":0},{"q":"How prevent hand-off loops?","qKn":"ಹಸ್ತಾಂತರ loops ಹೇಗೆ ತಡೆಯುವುದು?","opts":["Track the path and cap the number of hops","Ignore them","Add more agents","Delete state"],"optsKn":["ಹಾದಿ ಗಮನಿಸಿ ಹಾಪ್ ಮಿತಿ ಹಾಕಿ","ನಿರ್ಲಕ್ಷಿಸಿ","ಹೆಚ್ಚು agents","state ಅಳಿಸಿ"],"correct":0}]}}]

title: Orchestration Patterns: Supervisor, Swarm, Hierarchical — Choosing and Evaluating a Pattern
titleKn: Orchestration ಮಾದರಿಗಳು — ಮಾದರಿ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ
desc: A decision guide for picking an orchestration pattern and measuring whether it beats a simpler design.
objectives: Match a pattern to task structure.
Measure quality, cost and latency against a single-agent baseline.
Identify signs that a design is over-engineered.

Open-ended routing between specialists suggests a swarm. Very large decomposable problems suggest a hierarchy. If the task is small, one agent may be enough.","bodyKn":"ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ಉಪಕಾರ್ಯಗಳಿಗೆ supervisor ಅಡಿ ಸಮಾನಾಂತರ workers. ತಜ್ಞರ ನಡುವೆ ತೆರೆದ routing ಗೆ swarm. ಬಹಳ ದೊಡ್ಡ ವಿಭಜನೀಯ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗೆ ಶ್ರೇಣಿ. ಕೆಲಸ ಚಿಕ್ಕದಾದರೆ ಒಂದು agent ಸಾಕು."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Compare to a Baseline","headingKn":"ಆಧಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ","bodyEn":"Evaluate a single well-prompted agent with tools on the same tasks. Adopt a multi-agent pattern only if it improves quality enough to justify its extra cost, latency and debugging effort.","bodyKn":"ಅದೇ ಕೆಲಸಗಳಲ್ಲಿ tools ಇರುವ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತಮ agent ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಮಾಡಿ. ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟ ಸುಧಾರಣೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ವೆಚ್ಚ, ವಿಳಂಬ, debugging ಶ್ರಮ ಸಮರ್ಥಿಸಿದರೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಬಹು-agent ಮಾದರಿ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Signs of Over-Engineering","headingKn":"ಅತಿ-ವಿನ್ಯಾಸದ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳು","bodyEn":"Agents whose roles overlap, layers that only forward messages, and coordination messages that outnumber real work all point to unnecessary structure. • ಅಳೆದ ಲಾಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ.
• ಮೌಲ್ಯ ಸೇರಿಸದ ಪದರ ತೆಗೆಯಿರಿ."}},{"type":"quiz","data":{"questions":[{"q":"What suggests parallel workers under a supervisor?","qKn":"supervisor ಅಡಿ ಸಮಾನಾಂತರ workers ಯಾವುದು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ?","opts":["Independent subtasks","One tiny step","No tools","Only one agent"],"optsKn":["ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ಉಪಕಾರ್ಯಗಳು","ಒಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ಹಂತ","tools ಇಲ್ಲ","ಒಂದೇ agent"],"correct":0},{"q":"When adopt a multi-agent pattern?","qKn":"ಬಹು-agent ಮಾದರಿ ಯಾವಾಗ?","opts":["When measured gains justify extra cost","Always","Never","When it sounds impressive"],"optsKn":["ಅಳೆದ ಲಾಭ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಸಮರ್ಥಿಸಿದಾಗ","ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ","ಎಂದಿಗೂ ಇಲ್ಲ","ಪ್ರಭಾವಶಾಲಿ ಎನಿಸಿದಾಗ"],"correct":0},{"q":"Which is a sign of over-engineering?","qKn":"ಅತಿ-ವಿನ್ಯಾಸದ ಸೂಚನೆ?","opts":["Layers that only forward messages","Clear roles","Traces","A baseline"],"optsKn":["ಸಂದೇಶ ಮಾತ್ರ ಮುಂದೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸುವ ಪದರಗಳು","ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ಪಾತ್ರ","traces","ಆಧಾರ"],"correct":0}]}}]
